    How bundles work

    Buying a bundle unlocks every skill inside it at once, and each skill lands in your library exactly as if you had bought it on its own: same SKILL.md files, same updates, same install steps.

    Bundle prices are always below the combined price of the individual skills, and free skills inside a bundle stay free. If you already own one of the skills, the bundle page shows which ones you have before you pay.

    Prefer to pick skills one at a time? Browse the full catalogue or start with free skills.
